name: get_company_overview
description: Fetches real-time company fundamentals from Alpha Vantage: name, sector, industry, market cap, P/E ratio, EPS, dividend yield, 52-week range, analyst price target, and beta. Requires ALPHA_VANTAGE_API_KEY. Use this for due diligence, investment analysis, and competitive comparisons.

symbol.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g. 'AAPL', 'TSLA', 'MSFT'). Must be a valid US exchange ticker.
